description: Use this when the user asks about an existing OlaChill booking, order or quotation request and gives both its reference (for example TOKY-1018-0427 or BUS-FR-1018-0427) and the email address used when booking. Returns the service, travel date, party size, current status and what happens next. Read-only. Do not use it to find new products, to change or cancel a booking (send the user to the manage-booking page it returns), or without both the reference and the email; never guess either.

booking_id.description: Booking or request reference exactly as shown in the OlaChill email.

email.description: Email address used for the booking.

locale.description: Language for product names and page links (en, ja, ko, zh = Simplified Chinese, tw = Traditional Chinese, es, fr, de, it, th, id, vi). Default en.

name: get_booking_status

error.description: Present only when the call failed; a short reason the user can act on.

title: Check a booking or request
